shared_rules: work only inside the repo; write only your out path under reports/round-43/

never edit filed bytes: reports/round-1..42/**, corpus/lessons/*.md, tools/gates/frozen/**, fleet .ufo/**; corpus/instrument changes are DRAFTED as fenced blocks, integrator-applied; NEVER stage under corpus/ directly
no git commits/pushes/installs/network; export TMPDIR=$PWD/.scratch PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ABSOLUTE: never run reports/round-*/run-validation.py in-tree; NO re-freeze of declared-in-r7; no packet-surface changes
before proposing any corpus landing path, verify it against the live partition (ls corpus/knowledge/myth-symbol/) — never overwrite an existing entry; report collisions, do not route around them
every claim cites file:line or command output; unknowns to-verify; never fabricate

seats.mission: Resolver scout: read reports/round-39/calib/basename-couples-policy-full.md (the full policy incl. §4 group-alignment + §5 classes), reports/round-42/calib/ (the full successor doc), and the verbatim r39 landing it corrects. Locate the wrapped couples field's exact bytes (corpus/knowledge/linguistics/phonetics-phonology.md:72-77), the r19 filed instrument's parse code that zeroes it, and the fix surface. Report the four policy classes and what a conformant tool must output.

Landing scout: confirm the r42 C01 spare (reports/round-42/cov/C01-mineral-spare.md) fenced bytes are intact and name the exact target filename under the myth-symbol naming convention. Verify the path is free in the live partition (ls corpus/knowledge/myth-symbol/). Re-run the absence sweep at the current 223 total to confirm the lithic slot is still unowned. Flag any collision.
Plans for all three claims: O's tool spec + selftest controls, C's landing sequence + README rev 2.5 edit, Ca's per-finding disposition list shape.

Cross-claim connector: how O's resolver output feeds the census, how C's landing interacts with the couples index (the new entry's own - couples: line is a resolver input), how Ca's dispositions cite the O/C evidence.

Author the resolver tool draft: tools/harness/basename-couples-resolver.py implementing the r39 policy — token extraction (single line + wrapped continuation), brace expansion, four classes (direct/fallback/unresolved/ambiguous), per-entry + totals report, every fallback mapping listed. Draft as a fenced block for integrator application.

Author the selftest controls: a wrapped-field positive control (the phonetics-phonology field must read 4/4 named targets), a synthetic phantom (basename matching zero files -> unresolved), a synthetic ambiguous (basename matching two files -> ambiguous), and a direct positive. Draft the --selftest leg as a fenced block.

Predicted census: dry-run the resolver logic against the live corpus by hand/script-in-scratch; predict the four-class totals and name every expected fallback mapping + every expected unresolved/ambiguous token, citing the r37/r39 filed counts (334/319/15) as the comparison baseline.

Independent verifier 1: given O01's draft, trace its parse logic against the wrapped field bytes and the policy classes by reading (no execution of run-validation); confirm it would read 4/4 and never drop a token. Report pass/fail per requirement.

Independent verifier 2: hunt the traps — a token with a :NN anchor, a brace-expanded token, a token that is a pure basename with two index hits, a couples field that is the last header line. Confirm the draft's class assignment for each is the policy's, not a guess.

Disposition leg: author the per-row disposition output shape (each fallback -> explicit token->path mapping; each unresolved/ambiguous -> named reason, never dropped). Specify the --census output file format and the reports/round-43/calib/ census artifact name. Fenced draft.

Durability leg: name the canonical tool path, the shebang/CLI contract (--selftest/--census/[paths]), and how it relates to (does not edit) the filed r19 instrument and the r42 couples-reference-extractor. Confirm no .scratch dependency remains.

Policy-conformance check: read the full r39 policy doc end-to-end and checklist the O01 draft against each numbered clause (token extraction §1, two tiers §2, reporting §3, group-alignment §4, classes §5). Report any clause the draft misses.
O-claim scribe: assemble the claim-O evidence chain — draft + selftest spec + predicted census + two verifiers + policy-conformance — into the integration-ready summary the parent applies.

Census-output author: write the exact calib/census artifact the integrator files (four-class totals, every fallback mapping, the corrected 334/319/15 comparison). Reference shape only; integrator fills live numbers post-run.

Negative-proof verifier: confirm the draft never writes outside tools/harness/ + reports/round-43/, never edits the filed r19/r27/r28 instruments or corpus, and that the wrapped field is read not skipped. Report any write-surface violation.

Confirm-and-prepare the C01 lithic spare for landing: re-read reports/round-42/cov/C01-mineral-spare.md fenced bytes; confirm the entry contract (header fields, - couples:, - sources:, calibration, recheck, scope) is complete; state the exact target path under myth-symbol/ and confirm it is free. Report the byte range to apply.

README rev 2.5 draft: produce the exact README.md edits — new myth-symbol row in filename order, totals 223->224, footer dir_totals 26->27, a revision header noting the r43 lithic landing — as a fenced diff for the integrator.
Pre-landing audit 1: source-audit the C01 spare — every backticked in-repo path resolves at HEAD, every cited line number is real, no fabricated source. Report each citation's verify status.

Pre-landing audit 2: contract audit — the entry satisfies corpus/QUALITY.md (calibration present, living-practice flags, no canon claim, handoff target named) and the partition's naming/structure convention. Report pass/fail per clause.

Delta receipt: predict the post-landing sweep state (224==224) and author the staged-sha prediction note per the readme-prediction-vs-delivery durable practice — predict by staged-tree sha, cite post-apply sweep.

Collision verifier: independently enumerate corpus/knowledge/myth-symbol/ at HEAD, confirm the target filename is unused, and confirm landing the spare changes no other file. Report the full partition listing you observed.
C-claim scribe: assemble the claim-C evidence — prepare + README draft + two audits + delta receipt + collision verify — into the integration-ready summary.

Disposition-list author: for each of r39-review-findings-disposition, r38-O02-fragment-defects, r38-O08-fragment-defect, r38-O07-empty-fragment — read the cited evidence, re-run the measuring command where one exists (wc -c on the O07 fragment; grep/diff on the O02/O08 digests), and write one disposition row per finding: class + owner + cited evidence or could-not-recover. Fenced draft of calib/dispositions-r38-r39.

Disposition verifier: independently re-measure each of Ca01's four rows (run the same wc/grep/diff), confirm the class assigned matches the evidence, and confirm no filed byte was proposed for edit. Report per-row agree/disagree.

Queue-update author: draft the defect-queue-v2 successor entries (new records appended to a round-43 successor file, never editing reports/round-40/op/defect-queue-v2.json) reflecting the four dispositions. Fenced draft.

Non-author reviewer (required for any exploratory element): review the whole round's evidence chain — O's resolver + selftest + census, C's spare landing + README, Ca's dispositions. Named-verifier judgment per claim: improved / harmed / unchanged / unprovable-but-better, each with the evidence you read.

Second non-author reviewer: independent read of the three claims' landed evidence. Focus on whether any axis is harmed (does the resolver over-claim? does the landing overwrite? do dispositions edit filed bytes?). Per-axis verdict + named finding list.

Trades critic: hunt for any trade — an axis moved up while another is harmed (e.g. resolver lands but breaks the r42 extractor contract; coverage lands but README drifts; dispositions misclassify). Report each suspected trade with evidence.

Honesty critic: check every claimed number is measured not asserted (the 4/4 wrapped-field read, the 223->224 count, each disposition class). Flag any 'should work' wording. Verify no seat wrote outside its out path and nothing staged under corpus/.
Integration scribe: assemble the whole round — all three claims' evidence chains, the per-axis verdict candidates, the SHONEN section — into the integration draft the parent uses to land + judge.
Telemetry scribe: draft the observed-dispatch + availability-close-43 skeletons (owner, observation window, counting commands, durable source paths + sha256 placeholders the integrator fills).

Bleed/scope verifier: confirm no cross-domain bleed (no canon, no lore decision, no packet surface), PROVINCE.md still accurate, and the only corpus delta is the single C01 landing + README. Report any scope violation.
